import sys, zipfile, subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil
archive_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as z:
    names = sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.mafft'))
    with open(out_path, 'w') as out:
        for name in names:
            data = z.read(name)
            d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
            fpath = os.path.join(d, 'aln.fa')
            try:
                with open(fpath, 'wb') as f:
                    f.write(data)
                cp = subprocess.run(['phykit', 'parsimony_informative_sites', fpath], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
                token = cp.stdout.strip().split()[0]
                out.write(token + '\n')
            finally:
                shutil.rmtree(d)
PY
